title: Senior Lead Engineer- R&D (Hardware Design)
desc:
Job description:
Discover a Home for Your Talents
Beko Europe is a leading home appliance business dedicated to changing the lives of its customers through a wide range of innovative and sustainable household products and solutions.
Within the Beko community, every role feels like home, fostering a sense of belonging and growth. We value mutual respect, progressive thinking, and the power of diversity and inclusivity. Our commitment to sustainable development is driven by trust in technology and a dedication to producing confidently. As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your talents and contribute to building a prosperous future for all.
Apply Now and Be Part of Our Journey to Inspire Sustainable Lives in Every Home!
What awaits you in this role?
We are looking for a passionate
Senior Lead Engineer– R&D (Hardware Design)
who will join our team at
Hardware Technology Team.
Define global hardware requirements and design accordingly for required Arcelik products
Design hardware for new-generation devices to provide innovative and smart solutions,
Design cost-effective, reliable, robust, and well-documented hardware designs,
Managing individual deadlines and deliverables,
Working with internal and external partners.
The position is located in
Çayırova, İstanbul.
How do we describe the perfect match?
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering (M.Sc. would be a plus).
Minimum 9 years of experience in hardware design
Experience in designing Switch Mode Power Supply (AC-DC, DC-DC)
Experience in designing digital and analog circuits
Strong knowledge of the selection of MCU&MPU and peripherals
Design and analysis experience according to Safety and EMC standards
Strong knowledge of Schematic & PCB design (preferably Altium)
Strong knowledge of passive components
Experience with the interface of UART, I2C, SPI
Strong knowledge of lab equipment specs and usage (oscilloscope, power supply, signal generator, etc.)
Experienced in using simulation tools (preferably LTSpice or etc)
Excellent verbal and written skills in English
Following and adapting to market trends and new technologies,
Outside-the-box thinking ability,
Open to an innovation culture,
Flexible and open to new perspectives,
A great team player with a self-initiative mindset,
Knowing what empathy really means,
Being open to communication is always our priority.
At Beko, where it feels like home, we invite you to explore home of…
Global Minds:
Opportunities to learn, grow, and succeed together as one global team.
Impact:
Meaningful work that contributes to our communities, the environment, and a more sustainable future.
Innovation:
A culture that embraces new ideas and technologies and takes on challenges with confidence.
Camaraderie:
A culture of togetherness built on inclusion, care, respect, and mutual support.
Join the Beko Community to open a new chapter in your life journey, where growth, innovation, and personal fulfilment make it feels like home.
